description: PERMANENTLY delete an app and all its files. This is the most destructive call in this server and it cannot be undone: the files, the version history, the room data, the community entries and the users' saved data all go. Only call it when the developer has asked for that specific app to be deleted, in as many words. Before you do: get their code out (neblla_versions migrate, or neblla_git) and remember paying customers lose their entitlements, so settle any refunds in Stripe first. Neblla itself cancels the app's Pro subscription and its users' subscriptions, removes its custom domain and its history. A Google Play listing is on the developer's own Play account and stays: the answer's `left` names it, tell them to unpublish it in Play Console. If what they actually want is to stop hosting here, they do not need this at all — they can serve their own HTML from their own domain and keep Neblla as the backend (neblla_update_app addDomain).
name: neblla_delete_app
